widgets_values: 生成该产品10张详情页，所有页面比例保持统一，提示词如下：

要求：
只保留干货：只输出最终的6条提示词，每条代表每一屏。严禁有任何空行。
请开始输出：
输出全英文详情页（字体样式统一）

你是一位享誉全球的顶级电商创意总监，拥有为奢侈品、高科技、快消品、服饰等全品类产品策划详情页的深厚背景。你擅长拆解品牌调性，并将其转化为极其精准的 AI 图像描述词。
根据我上传的产品图，不要废话，直接输出以下全方位详情页策划方案。
1: 品牌与类目深度分析，在生成方案前，请先在后台分析以下要素：
类目识别： 属于什么类目？
调性锁定： 是什么风格？
目标人群： 他们的审美偏好与最关注的痛点是什么？
2: 视觉风格映射，根据1的结果，自动匹配以下视觉元素：
背景环境是什么？
光影逻辑是什么？
3: 制作6屏详情页方案，针对该产品，输出以下 6 屏的详细描述词。每一屏必需包含：主标题、副标题、信息布局、排版形式、风格与素材，且每一屏比例需保持一致。
例如：
首图海报 (Visual Impact)： 确立品牌地位。展示产品最具标志性的角度与光影氛围。
卖点展示一 (The Hero USP)： 解决核心痛点。展示产品如何改变用户的使用场景。
卖点展示二 (Tech/Innovation)： 硬核技术。透视、解构或极端环境下的稳定表现。
卖点展示三 (Material/Senses)： 材质细节。微距特写，传递触感、质感或气味感。
颜色展示 (Palette Showcase)： 审美排列。所有配色的静物阵列，强调色彩美学。
商品信息 (Pro Specs)： 材质、参数、等级、认证等硬核数据展示。
尺码/比例信息 (Size Guide)： 选购决策。通过参考物对比展示实际大小或穿搭推荐。
模特/生活化场景 (Lifestyle)： 建立联想。产品在真实高标场景中的使用瞬间。
细节深度展示 (Detail Macro)： 品质背书。特写缝隙、logo、按键、涂层等关键细节。
底部服务说明 (Trust & Brand)： 品牌故事背景、专业保养/洗涤建议及售后承诺。

9:16 vertical poster, high-end furniture cover look. Title: Hidden in Quietness, Revealed in Texture; Subtitle: Minimalist mid-century solid wood side table with fluted glass. Composition: large negative space, product centered slightly low, title centered top. Environment: warm-gray/oatmeal microcement wall, walnut/oak herringbone floor, soft linen curtain drape, slight foreground bokeh of Nandina or Monstera. Lighting: cinematic natural side-backlight at 4pm golden hour, dappled stripes through blinds or leaves; highlight fluted-glass refraction glow and brass pull specular. Lens: 85mm, low contrast, film grain, soft blacks. Color: quiet luxury, dark minimalist black wood. Typography: one elegant thin serif for all text.

9:16 vertical split-screen hero USP. Title: The Light Filter & Space Collector; Subtitle: Embossed fluted glass—light-transmitting, privacy-preserving—ends bedside clutter. Layout: left aligned copy, right visuals showing door half-open/closed and a close-up. Interior props: colorful books and small objects inside; through fluted glass they blur into soft abstract bands. Lighting: side/back glow from inside cabinet, golden hour dapple, emphasize ripple texture. Camera: crisp product close-up, shallow depth, filmic softness. Typography: single elegant thin serif.

9:16 full-bleed macro materials. Title: Time’s Flowing Gold, Warm to the Touch; Subtitle: Open-pore black wood grain × aged brass handle. Shot: extreme macro of wood pores and brass patina with slight oxidation, micro side light to reveal relief and micro-scratches, spark highlights on brass edges. Lens: 100mm macro, ultra shallow DOF, high micro-contrast, film grain. Palette: dark minimalist, tactile luxury. Typography: single elegant thin serif floating subtly over image.

9:16 lifestyle vignette. Title: One Square Meter of Relaxation; Subtitle: Bedside and sofa side—seamlessly woven into everyday rituals. Scene: warm living room or bedroom corner; side table holds a steaming black coffee, an open Kinfolk magazine, a vintage mushroom lamp; adjacent ivory linen sofa or low wooden bed. Environment: microcement wall, walnut/oak herringbone floor, linen curtain; sparse plant bokeh (Nandina/Monstera). Lighting: 4pm golden-hour side light, cinematic chiaroscuro, gentle shadows. Layout: top scene, bottom 1/3 solid tone block for lifestyle copy. Typography: single elegant thin serif.

9:16 tech/structure focus. Title: Elegant Stance, Unhindered Cleaning; Subtitle: slender splayed solid-wood high legs, visual lightness, robot vacuum passes freely. Camera: low angle at leg height, floor-level perspective; robot vacuum gliding under, clean background. Overlay: blueprint-style dimension lines and labels, 150mm (15 cm) floor clearance marked. Lighting: crisp side light, subtle reflections on herringbone floor. Typography: single elegant thin serif.

9:16 specs and trust grid. Title: Strict Creation, Precise Dimensions; Subtitle: product specs / environmental grade / service promise. Layout: Swiss-style grid; top: neutral light-gray front view with high-precision black-and-white three-view linework (top, front, side) and detailed measurements; middle: minimal icons—FSC-certified solid wood, E0 emissions, safety fluted glass, aged brass hardware; bottom: logistics and care—nationwide delivery, easy assembly, 3-year warranty, cleaning guidance for wood, glass, brass. Palette: calm gray/black, no distractions. Typography: single elegant thin serif.
